commentary: With market breadth scored at a defensive 44% and our deterministic market gate flagged WEAK, discipline must take precedence over aggression. Nifty 50 is stabilizing above 25,000 supported by institutional liquidity, yet Stan Weinstein's stage discipline warns against chasing breakouts in mixed tapes. William O'Neil's CANSLIM principles require strictly prioritizing high relative strength leaders backed by accelerating quarterly sales and EPS. Under current breadth conditions, progressive exposure and tight risk containment are paramount. We restrict capital to confirmed Stage 2 leaders exhibiting clean volatility contraction, while keeping emerging consolidation setups on strict watchlist until broader market follow-through emerges.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Constructing a double bottom base above its EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with neckline resistance at 114.91. Volume dry-up confirms supply contraction, but breakout conviction remains unproven.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe operational deterioration with latest quarterly revenues falling 56% YoY and net margins compressed near 1-2%. ROE of ~3% reflects weak capital productivity and fails CANSLIM growth criteria.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Break below 104.11 invalidates base support and violates key moving averages; enforce immediate loss-cutting.

AARON.technical: Cleared 20-session high at 148.04 on 1.21x volume. MACD is positive above signal line and zero line with consecutive higher swing lows confirming accumulation.
AARON.fundamental: Strong small-cap earnings acceleration driven by elevator manufacturing demand. Healthy ROCE near 18.7% and ROE of 15% with manageable leverage support CANSLIM institutional quality thresholds.
AARON.risk: Close below 134.59 breaches 20-day base low and moving average cushion, necessitating quick capital preservation.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: High-volume SEPA breakout clearing 497.45 backed by 23.57x average volume surge. Price structure trades decisively above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, signalling fresh Stage 2 momentum.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: API and formulation recovery drives robust operating leverage. OPM holds firm at 12-13% while ROCE of 12% and annual ROE above 13% reflect solid balance sheet execution.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: A close below 441.76 violates the explosive breakout candle low and SMA50, invalidating the setup.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Textbook 20-day breakout clearing 416.87 resistance on healthy volume. Momentum supported by RSI at 72 and positive MACD alignment well above key short and long-term averages.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Financial powerhouse delivering consistent >30% YoY PAT and sales expansion across lending and insurance arms. Strong institutional backing and expanding net worth provide top-tier CANSLIM sponsorship.
ABCAPITAL.risk: Failure to hold 391.92 invalidates breakout shelf support; cut exposure immediately per Minervini discipline.

ABDL.technical: Forming double bottom base with pivot trigger at 767.67. Constructive pullback to rising 21-EMA was defended with bullish reclaim candle, RSI 59 shows steady momentum.
ABDL.fundamental: Premium spirits portfolio drives double-digit revenue expansion of 16% YoY. While debt reduction post-IPO aids bottom-line recovery, quarterly EPS growth under 25% requires further confirmation.
ABDL.risk: A drop below 712.35 breaches key swing low support and 21-EMA; exit promptly.

ABSLBANETF.technical: Banking index tracker breaking out of a 20-session consolidation at 60.76 on 1.44x volume. Momentum confirmed by positive MACD crossover above zero.
ABSLBANETF.risk: Close below 58.68 breaks 20-day base low and terminates breakout momentum; strictly enforce stop.
